title: [EOPATCH2] AAPS deactivates the time change loop
symptom: In Spain, after the time change (from 3:00 to 2:00), users of the EOPATCH2 pump received a notification stating 'Daylight saving time change less than 3 hours ago - Closed loop disabled'. For 2 hours, the loop was disabled, only receiving programmed temporary basals. This happened to users with master version 3.2.0.1 as well as dev users.
cause: The thread indicates that this behavior is by design, as documented for time adjustment during daylight savings time. The DstHelper disables the closed loop for 3 hours after a DST change.
fix: No fix is provided; the behavior is considered working as expected. Users are directed to documentation on timezone traveling and DST.
evidence_quote: Check in Other Pumps. Is working as expected. No bug.
